slates.label: NBA picks: Fri Nov 20
slates.note: Two 2-leg parlays on four different games: Brooklyn +17.5 and Utah +15.5, where DK is about 3 points cheaper than the other books, plus Tari Eason's rebounds (Capela out, Sengun questionable) with Sacramento +29.5. The 3-leg parlay is dropped: every 3-leg that cleared the profit floor reused the same games, so both parlays are at the $50 tier.

parlays.why: Brooklyn +17.5 (81.9% fair vs 82.3% DK; 80.4% consensus no-vig, DK -465 vs -500 to -700 elsewhere, 3.3 pts cheaper): Orlando is -5.5 without Banchero, so the Nets only need to avoid an 18+ point loss. Utah +15.5 (79.7% fair vs 81.7% DK; 79.0% no-vig, DK 2.9 pts cheaper): Phoenix is -4.5, and the Jazz have failed the spread by 11+ in only 2 of 16 games; they beat the Lakers by 12 on Wednesday. The backtest's 'DK 3-5 pts cheaper' team-leg bucket is the cheapest NBA leg type (+0.9%). EV is about -3%, so $50.

Tari Eason 4+ rebounds (75.0% fair vs 75.2% DK; 77.0% consensus no-vig, up from 76.3% this morning; DK -304 vs -400 to -425 at FD/CZR/FAN/SCR, 4.8 pts cheaper): 4+ in 10 of his last 12 at 22-33 minutes. Capela is out and Sengun and Adams are questionable; our sim gives 83% with Sengun in and 91% with him out. Sacramento +29.5 (84.5% fair vs 86.7% DK; 83.7% no-vig, DK 2.2 pts cheaper): the Lakers are -14.5 without Reaves, and the Kings have failed the spread by 15+ in only 2 of 14 games. EV is about -3%, so $50.

pickem.why: De-vigged ML 68% (Pinnacle); Charlotte is 4-10, -7.0 ATS per game, and without Allen, Williams, Knueppel and Schroder on the 4th stop of a road trip.

De-vigged ML 82%; New Orleans is without Murray and Mathurin, with Murphy questionable.
De-vigged ML 62% for Phoenix; Utah is 3-13 without Markkanen, Jackson Jr. and Nurkic.
Coin flip: market favorite Denver at 53% de-vigged. My power model leans Houston (12-4), but Sengun and Adams are questionable and Capela is out, so I take the favorite.
De-vigged ML 86%; the Kings are 1-13 (-12.3 per game adjusted), which outweighs Reaves being out.

slates.label: NBA picks: Thu Nov 19
slates.note: First NBA slate: two 2-leg parlays built on Memphis covering against a Curry-less Warriors team and the Knicks' scoring staying in check at Minnesota. The 3-leg parlay is dropped because no 3-leg combination cleared the profit floor; every NBA leg costs 1-4 points against the no-vig market. Portland legs are skipped with Avdija and Camara questionable.

parlays.why: Memphis +3.5 (78% fair vs 78% book, 74% consensus no-vig): Golden State is -15.6 per game without Curry and lost its last three by 21, 22 and 38; both teams are on a back-to-back. Knicks team total Under 117.5 (79% vs 81%): Minnesota's defense holds teams to about 105, my model projects New York at 104.7 against a 108.5 main line, and New York topped 117 once in its last 8. EV is just under break-even, so it gets the $50 tier.

Towns 11+ rebounds (76.5% fair vs 75.5% book; Pinnacle no-vig 76.6%, DK 1.3 pts cheaper than the other books): 11+ in each of his last 10 games (avg 14.1 in 34 min), the Knicks have no injuries, and his main line is 13.5. Memphis +5.5 (82% fair vs 83% book) for the same Curry-absence reason as parlay 1, two points safer.

pickem.why: Model 72% vs 68% de-vigged ML: Golden State is -15.6 per game without Curry (lost the last 3 by 21-38), and both teams are on a back-to-back.
De-vigged ML 88%: Spurs are 12-3 with Wembanyama healthy, and LA is without Ingram and Beal; Harper's absence is priced in.
De-vigged ML 78%, shaded down for Avdija (25.6 ppg) and Camara being questionable; Milwaukee is 1-14 and on the second night of a back-to-back.
Coin flip: market favorite at 51% de-vigged. My power model leans Minnesota, but that isn't enough to flip a near pick'em, and Kuminga is questionable.
